lines.text: Your issues are monsters!
lines.el: [shouts] Your issues are MONSTERS!

lines.text: Your AI agents are units!
lines.el: [excited] Your AI agents... are UNITS!

lines.text: GBrain is their shared memory!
lines.el: [excited] G Brain is their shared memory!
lines.say: G Brain is their shared memory!

lines.text: And River forges new unit types!
lines.el: [excited] And River forges NEW unit types!

lines.text: This is QM RAID!
lines.el: [excited] This is... Q M RAID!

lines.text: Hear ye! Pick a knight, a real QM agent. Point it at a camp.
lines.el: Hear ye! Pick a knight, a real Q M agent. Point it at a camp.
lines.say: Hear ye! Pick a knight, a real Q M agent. Point it at a camp.

lines.text: Blue beam: it recalls from GBrain.
lines.el: Blue beam: it recalls from G Brain.
lines.say: Blue beam: it recalls from G Brain.

lines.text: It works the issue for real.
lines.el: It works the issue... for real.

lines.text: Gold orb: it remembers what it learned.
lines.el: Gold orb: it remembers what it learned.

lines.text: Three units, one team: the Trio.
lines.el: Three units, one team: the Trio.

lines.text: Right-click a camp, and the scrolls fly.
lines.el: Right-click a camp... and the scrolls fly!

lines.text: The reviewer is a Rule Warden, forged by River. It checks the house rules.
lines.el: The reviewer is a Rule Warden, forged by River. It checks the house rules.

lines.text: Verdict: approved! The camp falls.
lines.el: [excited] Verdict: APPROVED! The camp falls.

lines.text: Verdict: changes! Back to the anvil, implementer.
lines.el: Verdict: changes! Back to the anvil, implementer.

lines.text: A new kind of unit? To the Forge! Describe a Refund Ranger.
lines.el: A new kind of unit? [excited] To the Forge! Describe a Refund Ranger.

lines.text: River fine-tunes a model on orders the Forge writes.
lines.el: River fine-tunes a model on orders the Forge writes.

lines.text: It beats the base model on held-out test orders.
lines.el: It beats the base model on held-out test orders.

lines.text: Train one, and out it walks.
lines.el: Train one, and out it walks!

lines.text: A new issue? A fresh camp appears.
lines.el: A new issue? A fresh camp appears.

lines.text: Autopilot proposes orders, each on a fifteen second veto ring.
lines.el: Autopilot proposes orders, each on a fifteen second veto ring.

lines.text: Cancel one. Let one ride.
lines.el: Cancel one. [mischievously] Let one ride.

lines.text: Open a knight's loadout: standing orders, skills, and plugins, GBrain among them.
lines.el: Open a knight's loadout: standing orders, skills, and plugins, G Brain among them.
lines.say: Open a knight's loadout: standing orders, skills, and plugins, G Brain among them.

lines.text: Save new standing orders, and its very next order carries them.
lines.el: Save new standing orders, and its very next order carries them.

lines.text: One human. Thirty-one AI agents. Built today.
lines.el: One human. Thirty-one AI agents. Built today.

lines.text: One human, a swarm of AI agents, built today.
lines.el: One human, a swarm of AI agents, built today.
